flags.title: No official source for betting lines/odds exists
flags.detail: The NBA does not publish spreads, moneylines, totals or prop lines. Market columns in pipeline datasets are permanently blank by policy.

flags.title: NBA.com odds UI values not extractable from fetched pages
flags.detail: Schedule/game pages expose a Hide Odds toggle, but no odds values appear in the server HTML (0 occurrences of odds fields in games_*.html payloads). Not recorded.

flags.title: cdn.nba.com 403 / stats.nba.com timeouts from datacenter clients
flags.detail: Recorded in data/manifest.json; pipeline falls back to www.nba.com HTML (canonical) and ESPN partner API for cross-check/player data.

flags.title: Player stat verification: official NBA leader lines + full-box sample all matched ESPN
flags.detail: 184/184 NBA-listed game-leader stat lines (PTS/REB/AST for the same named player) match ESPN boxes across 92 games; full-box sample: game 0022600002, 3/3 players (LeBron James 14/9/7, Joel Embiid 13/11/6, Jaylen Brown 19/8/6) matched the NBA official box-score page (https://www.nba.com/game/phi-vs-nyk-0022600002/box-score). Non-leader player rows remain partner-sourced only. Note: NBA 'teamLeader' is not always the team's top scorer (e.g., 0022600002 NYK lists Towns 19/12/1 while ESPN shows Brunson 21) — selection semantics differ; stat values agree.
